# Sakshi Forge — Electropolished Stainless Steel Pipes & Tubes Manufacturer, Mumbai, India

> Sakshi Forge manufactures electropolished (EP) stainless steel pipes and tubes in grades
> 304, 304L, 316 and 316L (904L supplied electropolished), to ASTM A270, A269, A249 and A312,
> with ASME BPE surface finishes SF1 and SF4. Every order ships with an EN 10204 3.1 certificate
> traced to the heat number, PMI on every length and an internal Ra report for each EP lot.
> ISO 9001:2015; NABL-accredited laboratory testing. Quotation within 24 hours; dispatch and
> transit are confirmed in writing with each quotation.
